options.name: dense_discovery
options.rowGridBehavior: Two-column phone grid and four-column tablet grid; featured content may span all columns but may not displace more than one discovery row.
options.portraitLandscapeBehavior: Increase columns when the available window crosses 600 and 840 logical units; never stretch media outside 16:9 or lock orientation.
options.creatorIdentity: Creator avatar and name remain visible in one compact metadata row.
options.liveState: Live badge and viewer state remain visible over the media edge without obscuring primary content.
options.expectedImpact: Highest browsing efficiency and the most titles visible per viewport.
options.tradeoffs: Less room for artwork, creator storytelling, and featured-event emphasis.

options.name: cinematic
options.rowGridBehavior: Single-column phone stream and two-column tablet grid; one optional featured hero may use a 2:1 crop with a protected focal region.
options.portraitLandscapeBehavior: Landscape uses two columns when height permits; compact-height windows retain one horizontal carousel and preserve media ratio.
options.creatorIdentity: Creator avatar, name, and one supporting identity line receive a dedicated metadata band.
options.liveState: Live state receives a prominent badge plus elapsed or scheduled state adjacent to creator identity.
options.expectedImpact: Strongest artwork and featured-content emphasis with clear event storytelling.
options.tradeoffs: Lowest browsing density and more scrolling before users can compare titles.

options.name: creator_balanced
options.rowGridBehavior: Peekable horizontal rows on compact phones and a three-column tablet grid; featured content is limited to the first row.
options.portraitLandscapeBehavior: Compact landscape uses two balanced columns; medium and expanded windows use three or four columns without changing the 16:9 media ratio.
options.creatorIdentity: Creator avatar and name are first-class; a compact secondary line may show category or recency.
options.liveState: Live badge, viewer state, and creator identity remain visible without reducing the interactive card target.
options.expectedImpact: Streaming-style density while preserving creator identity and live-state prominence.
options.tradeoffs: More layout rules than the other options and less artwork emphasis than the cinematic option.
